lines.4: Apparently her cooking didn't turn out again.
lines.5: This is practically becoming our standard meal.
lines.6: We talk as I eat a rice ball filled with crab mayonnaise.
lines.7: 「What sort of work does the vice president do?」
lines.9: 「The Princess does her work flawlessly, so the vice president is little more than an ornament. That is why I can serve as disciplinary chair at the same time.」
lines.10: 「As a rule, you will be fine as long as you do what the Princess says.」
lines.11: 「If there is anything you do not understand, ask me when it comes up.」
lines.13: 「So, do you think you can find someone?」
lines.14: 「No luck today. I'll try again tomorrow.」
lines.15: 「I see. It is reassuring to know you are thinking it through and making an effort.」
lines.16: 「You may rely on me, but save that for when you have tried everything you can and it still has not worked.」
lines.19: I think I'll turn in early tonight.
